## The following processes are executed only when updating the camera body.     ##
# if OneNAND boot, get backup.bin from OneNAND.
# WA Overflowing tmp area. Delete unnecessary files.
test -f $FILE_MOUNTCONF || { echo "[ERROR] config/mount.conf not found" ; getledval.elf $ERROR_FIRMWARE ; exit $? ; }
test -f $FILE_PARTINF || { echo "[ERROR] partconf/partinf.conf not found" ; getledval.elf $ERROR_FIRMWARE ; exit $? ; }
echo "[ERROR] unknown action mode" ; getledval.elf $ERROR_FIRMWARE ; exit $? ;
mount -t vfat /dev/nflasha2 /setting $VFAT_MOUNT_OPTION_SYNC || { echo "[ERROR]nflasha2 mount failed" ; blink_error_exit $ERROR_NAND_MOUNT ; }
#User or Minor or version sikp or mscrypt exit OK
mount -t vfat /dev/nflasha2 /setting $VFAT_MOUNT_OPTION_SYNC || { echo "[ERROR]nflasha2 mount failed" ; blink_error_exit $ERROR_NAND_MOUNT ; }
# Parse the console line. No options specified if
for aset in $CPUSET_CPUS; do mkdir -p $DEVCGRP/cpu$aset; done
for aset in $CPUSET_CPUS; do eval echo '$'CPUSET_$aset > $DEVCGRP/cpu$aset/cpuset.cpus; done
for aset in $CPUSET_CPUS; do echo 0 > $DEVCGRP/cpu$aset/cpuset.mems; done
exec busybox chroot . /bin/ash -c "busybox umount $ROOTFS_OLDTGT; freeramdisk /dev/ram0; /sbin/init2;" < dev/console > dev/console 2>&1
# now we set cpuset assuming that we are running on child process of init
